messages:
maria: FYI docs PR #2145 (migration guide) is stuck in preview — linkcheck failing and CI flaky. tagging reviewers. Anyone able to take a quick look?

ajay: I'll check. linkcheck output in CI shows two 404s:

```
[link-check] ERROR: 404 https://internal.redwood.com/docs/old-metrics -> referenced in /docs/migration/v2.md: line 112
[link-check] ERROR: 404 https://partner.example.com/deploy -> referenced in /docs/migration/v2.md: line 218
```

ajay: Looks like the old docs site moved. Could be a redirect missing.

docs-bot: CI: docs-preview failed — linkcheck, vale-grammar. Rerun with `ci rerun` after fixes. :warning:

lucas: I can fix the internal link to point to /docs/metrics/rdw-metrics (short patch). For partner link—do we want to keep external or vendor page? @jen any context?

jen: partner link is third-party; prefer to link to the partner's canonical blog. I can confirm their new URL. I'll post here.

jen: partner's article is at https://partner.example.com/blog/redwood-deploy-updates-2025 (new). will update.

maria: Great — can one of you open a tiny patch branch (fix/linkcheck-pr2145) and include a CI-only commit to force a preview rebuild? The preview has been flaky lately.

ajay: Pushed branch fix/linkcheck-pr2145 with two commits: link fixes + tweak to avoid passive voice flagged by vale in migration intro.

ajay: Vale error before fix:
```
[vale] migration/v2.md:45 Passive voice: "was deprecated" -> prefer active phrasing
```

ajay: I rephrased to "We deprecated" — should silence vale.

ci-bot: Rerun triggered by ajay. Rebuilding docs preview (job 38291). :arrows_counterclockwise:

docs-bot: Note: we treat linkcheck 404s as merge-blockers. If the external link is unreachable, mark it with `[dead-link]` and add a comment explaining.

lucas: After running locally with `npx markdown-link-check docs/migration/v2.md -q` all links now pass.

maria: Thanks — I'll wait for the preview to go green. If it flakes again, we'll merge under `docs/ci-preview:unstable` exception and follow-up with a post-merge fix plan.

jen: Preview passed for me — screenshot attached. :thumbsup:

maria: ok merging after 10 min window for other reviewers. @docs-approvers please ack.

lucas: ack

ajay: ack

jen: ack

maria: merged and released. Closing the follow-up ticket for flaky preview logic #342. Thanks all! :tada:
